gameDescriptionHtml:
Dust Raiders is a management strategy game, set in a lawless wasteland. Upgrade your vehicles, engage in tactical fights against raiders hunting for your resources and gather a crew to rule the area.

Everything did not go according to the plan. Sooner or later, being in control of the refinery could slip away from your hands. And well… It did. The deadly Sawblade attack took everything from you. Your friend, Victor, is gone. Fuel gone. Equipment gone. Crew members gone. Time to assemble the first vehicle from scrap, gather a new crew and get back on track. There is no time to waste, because The Great Storm is coming.

Game Features

  • Tactical Vehicle Combat – As you embark on desert expeditions, combat will be inevitable. Take command of your crew and make the most of a wide array of weapons to survive and win your battles!
  • Dynamic economy – Dust Raiders features a dynamic economy system with demand and supply, and random events that can affect the market. You’ll need to make strategic decisions about what goods to buy and sell to maximize your profits.
  • Ride customization – Helping struggling enclaves, finishing quests and gathering crew members will unlock new customization options for your vehicles.
  • Vast hostile areas to explore – In order to complete main story and side missions you will need to explore four huge hostile areas ranging from borders of Eternal Desert, through contaminated marshes and abandoned Polis.
